title: PatchSetStaleResponse
description: 409 body for POST /api/patch-sets/apply refused because one or more targets changed since the preview their fingerprints came from (HEL-1458). Nothing was applied. `message` names every stale edit (index, kind, id) so clients that surface only `message` (the MCP tools) still show them; `staleTargets` is the structured form.

index.description: The edit's position in the applied patch set's edits array.
